import { Controller, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { BullModule, InjectQueue, Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Job, Queue } from 'bullmq';
import { Entity, PrimaryColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';

@Entity('report_job')
class ReportJobEntity {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

interface GeneratePdfPayload {
  readonly reportId: string;
}

@Injectable()
class ReportsService {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('reports')
    private readonly reportsQueue: Queue<GeneratePdfPayload, void, string>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-colocated-reports
  async enqueue(reportId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.reportsQueue.add('generate-pdf', { reportId });
  }
}

@Controller('reports')
class ReportsController {
  constructor(private readonly reports: ReportsService) {}

  @Post()
  async create(): Promise<void> {
    await this.reports.enqueue('report-1');
  }
}

@Processor('reports')
class ReportsProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(ReportJobEntity)
    private readonly reports: Repository<ReportJobEntity>,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<unknown, unknown, string>, _token?: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.reports.save({ id: String(job.name) });
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [BullModule.forRoot({}), BullModule.registerQueue({ name: 'reports' })],
  controllers: [ReportsController],
  providers: [ReportsService, ReportsProcessor],
})
class ReportsModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: colocated');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
